item.title: Roadster thumbnail reference
item.description:
This post exists to test the thumbnail functionality that is already provided by the Roadster theme.

The image should appear as a thumbnail in the post list, with the title and text flowing beside it on desktop.

The same theme mechanism is also reused for the project overview in this Step 002 experiment.
